name: Colosseum Inspired UI Overhaul
author: Community
description: Standalone Colosseum-inspired presentation/UI update for Gen I/II, synchronized to Colosseum Overhaul 2.0.1. Includes the newest battle HUD, menus, mobile scaling, Colosseum portraits, expanded ColosseumDex display bridge, information-model showroom integration, UI color controls, doubles targeting/HUD compatibility and release polish. CBE is optional; when installed, this UI consumes its doubles, abilities, ColosseumDex and information-model services.
